title: W11416395 — Service Test Mode
description: Enter Service Test Mode via Key 2 then START; auto-sequence runs valves, drain, wash, spin.

source.manualTitle: Maytag 4.8 cu ft Top Load Washer (MVW6200, W11416395B)

steps.title: Enter Service Test Mode
steps.body: With Service Diagnostic mode active, press and release Key 2, then press and release START. All LEDs turn on indicating successful entry. Press START again to begin automatic test sequence: water valves → drain pump → wash (CW/CCW agitate) → spin (140/300/500 rpm). Key 1 repeats prior step; Key 2 skips. Door must be closed. POWER exits to standby.
steps.sourceExcerpt: To enter Service test mode, press and release Key 2... then press and release the START button.
